ministry: Department of Women and Child Development and Social Welfare, Government of West Bengal
benefits_summary: Monthly financial assistance of ₹1,200 for SC/ST women and ₹1,000 for General/OBC women transferred directly to their bank account.
exclusions: Women with permanent employment in Central or State Government, PSUs, or statutory bodies
documents_required: Swasthya Sathi Card or Official Identity Proof
application_steps: Collect the free application form at a Duare Sarkar camp or Block Development Office (BDO) / Urban Local Body office.
Fill in personal and bank details and attach self-attested copies of required documents.
Submit the form at the Duare Sarkar camp for verification and DBT sanction.
